description_en: Queries the details of all compliance pack templates provided by CloudConfig
description_zh: 查询配置审计提供的所有合规包模板及其详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun config list-compliance-pack-templates --compliance-pack-template-id ct-5f26ff4e06a300c40000 --rule-risk-level 2 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --filter-type LAW --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCompliancePackTemplates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the compliance pack template
parameters.name: compliance_pack_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the rules in the compliance pack. Valid values:

- 1: high
- 2: medium
- 3: low
parameters.help_zh:
合规包中规则模板的风险等级。取值：
- 1：高风险。
- 2：中风险。
- 3：低风险
parameters.name: rule_risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource type that is evaluated by the rules. If you specify this parameter, only the compliance pack templates that contain rules for the specified resource type are returned
parameters.help_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。输入该参数时，只返回合规包模板中包括该资源类型的规则
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The field used to filter the query results
parameters.name: filter_type
